meta.name: Film Club
meta.description: Friday night. 7pm. Film Club Week 198. Evie hasn't left the house in six months after a 'wobble', and Film Club is her escape. A weekly chance to create a world of wonder, deck the garage out in whatever the movie calls for and spend a few uninterrupted hours with Noa - her best friend and one of the few mates who still shows up. But tonight, things are different. Noa's got big news. A dream job is taking him across the other side of the country, which means that all of this is ending.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Best friends Evie and Noa have watched films together since they first met. But now Noa has news which is set to change everything.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While Noa attends a taster day for his new job in Bristol, Evie pulls out all the stops for Film Club – there's a lot riding on tonight.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Evie's still reeling from the message she saw on Noa's phone. But when the two are left alone together, something extraordinary happens. Is it the start of a new journey for Evie?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Evie throws herself headlong at life, Suz and Josh worry it's too much, too soon. Meanwhile, Noa realises he has to face up to his feelings...

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Her world rocked, Evie has retreated to the safety of the garage. But with a new understanding, Suz and Izzie create a unique version of Film Club to bring back Evie's smile.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Noa didn't want a big goodbye, but now the day's finally come for him to leave, will Evie let him go that easily? It's not the only big decision she has to face...
